svg.title: What each client did in the probe
svg.text: The same probe in each client, against the Spark 4.3.0 server (measured for this chapter)
reattach: ReattachExecute calls for the 20 MB result when the server ends each stream after 1 MiB.
Go v0.1.0 sends its executions as not reattachable, so it never needs to reattach.
